## Selected Projects

### Predicting Emergency Department Demand

Built a one-quarter-ahead forecasting prototype for total ED encounters across 57 New York facility counties and 28 quarters. Developed a leakage-safe data pipeline, compared machine-learning models with operational benchmarks, and found that previous-quarter persistence achieved the best 2024 holdout performance (**MAE 1,253; WAPE 3.36%**). Deployed the stakeholder workflow as a Flask application on Render.

**Tools:** Python, Pandas, Scikit-learn, XGBoost, SHAP, Flask, Render  
[View Project](projects/predicting-emergency-department-demand.html) | [Watch Demo](videos/projects/ed-demand/ed-demand-app-demo.mp4){target="_blank"} | [Open Live App](https://ny-quarterly-ed-demand-app.onrender.com/){target="_blank"}

### TMDB Movie Recommender

Built a content-based recommendation system for 5,000 TMDB movies using plot summaries, genres, keywords, directors, and leading cast. Applied TF-IDF and cosine similarity to rank related titles; **90% of top-10 recommendations shared at least one genre** across 100 sampled movies. Deployed the interactive workflow as a Streamlit application on Render.

**Tools:** Python, Pandas, Scikit-learn, TF-IDF, Streamlit, Render  
[View Project](projects/movie-recommender.html) | [Watch Demo](videos/projects/movie-recommender/movie-recommender-app-demo.mp4){target="_blank"} | [Open Live App](https://tmdb-movie-recommender-app.onrender.com/){target="_blank"}

### EV Adoption in Washington

Analyzed more than 235,000 Washington State EV registration records to examine adoption growth, leading brands, electric range, and geographic concentration. Transformed the findings into a focused four-visual data story using Polars and Plotly.

**Tools:** Python, Polars, Plotly  
[View Project](projects/ev-adoption.html)
